title: GCI Outdoor LevrUp Pop Up Canopy Tent, 8x8

comparisons.notes: GCI Outdoor LevrUp Canopy 8x8, shipped and sold by GCI Outdoor; tan offered, no out-of-stock notice. Exact match model 870314, UPC 631444012153.

writeup: The GCI Outdoor LevrUp 8x8 pop-up canopy in tan (model 870314) is $69.05 at Woot, while Macy's, where it's sold by GCI Outdoor itself, lists the same canopy at $230. That's 69% less. Its LevrLock lever lets one person raise the frame from outside, and Woot showed only 3 left at last check.
